Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Find AbstractInsertion in Level 1 of MutantMania. Give her Okon's check in exchange for the action figure.

They put out a new action figure for one of the setth that I collect. Thith new figure has a rare cuthtom paint job. I bought one through ectoBay. The theller'th name is AbstractInsertion. I buy thtuff from her all the time. She'th a great perthon, not like that jerk UndercoverPancaketh975, except I think she getth beat up a lot. Anyway, AbstractInsertion has some pretty awethome thtuff. Would you do me a favor and trade her my check for the action figure?
